adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `poll_feed` iterates `rss.items.each` and calls `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and `TopicEmbed.import(...)` with no per-item error handling. Any exception from a single malformed item (e.g., `i.content` nil causing `NoMethodError`, or an exception inside `TopicEmbed.import`) will terminate the whole job run, preventing remaining items from being imported. Since the job sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, a failing run won’t be retried, so later items can be skipped until the next scheduled run (and could be perpetually skipped if the same bad item continues to trigger the exception). Also, `feed_key`/modified tracking is defined but unused, so there’s no implemented resumption/last-seen mechanism in this diff.
